paradisecay.name: Tiburon Pier (Romberg Tiburon Center), ERDDAP dataset tiburon-weather-tibc1

paradisecay.name: Richmond (Chevron Long Wharf / Berth 5)
paradisecay.how_to_read: NOAA CO-OPS PORTS: 6-min wind (knots, with gust & dir) at https://api.tidesandcurrents.noaa.gov/api/prod/datagetter?product=wind&station=9414863&date=latest&units=english&time_zone=lst_ldt&format=json ; also NDBC realtime2 https://www.ndbc.noaa.gov/data/realtime2/RCMC1.txt (m/s) and, for some ids, https://api.weather.gov/stations/RCMC1/observations/latest (km/h). Free, scriptable, no key.
paradisecay.notes: On the Richmond Long Wharf across the channel from Paradise Cay; open-water exposure to W/SW. Best free scriptable sensor for this launch.

crissy.name: Crissy Field (Anita Rock) sensor
crissy.how_to_read: iKitesurf / WeatherFlow Tempest network: view at https://wx.ikitesurf.com/spot/<unknown> (free account shows current reading; graphs/history need paid membership). No free API. View-only.
crissy.notes: COORDS APPROXIMATE (placed at Anita Rock off the beach; exact mount and spot id not found). Per Mike Godsey (WeatherFlow) it is accurate in NW ocean wind but reads well above the beach in WSW/eddy/marine-surge flow because it sits just above the Presidio wind shadow. View-only.

crissy.name: San Francisco (Fort Point)
crissy.how_to_read: NOAA CO-OPS PORTS: 6-min wind (knots, with gust & dir) at https://api.tidesandcurrents.noaa.gov/api/prod/datagetter?product=wind&station=9414290&date=latest&units=english&time_zone=lst_ldt&format=json ; also NDBC realtime2 https://www.ndbc.noaa.gov/data/realtime2/FTPC1.txt (m/s) and, for some ids, https://api.weather.gov/stations/FTPC1/observations/latest (km/h). Free, scriptable, no key.
crissy.notes: On the Fort Point / Crissy Field seawall at the Golden Gate, 0.6 mi W of the launch; the station Windfinder labels "Crissy Field". Reads the ocean-wind side of the beach; the beach itself sits in the Presidio wind shadow on WSW/eddy days.
